Region Hovedstaden is one of the five Danish healthcare regions and plays a leading role in the national management and quality assurance of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment. As a major contributor to the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD), the region provides extensive clinical data and supplies several members to the database's steering committee, reflecting its substantial clinical capacity [^src1]. The region's involvement is part of a broader national effort to systematize IBD treatment through cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and evidence-based guidelines.

In terms of patient demographics and clinical workload, Region Hovedstaden handles a significant portion of the country's IBD cases. Between October 1, 2022, and September 30, 2023, the region registered 11,211 IBD patients, the highest absolute number among the five regions [^src1]. The diagnostic breakdown within the region showed that [[dk50-crohns-sygdom|DK50* Crohns sygdom]] accounted for 40% of all IBD patients, while [[dk51-ulceroes-colitis|DK51* Ulcerøs colitis]] made up 58% [^src1]. Additionally, the region treated 128 patients with [[dk830f-primaer-skleroserende-kolangitis|DK830F Primær skleroserende kolangitis]], a severe comorbid condition, which was notably higher than the numbers reported by [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src1].

The region's healthcare infrastructure includes facilities such as [[nordsjaellands-hospital|Nordsjællands Hospital]], which has provided detailed operational explanations for quality indicators like biomarker monitoring and patient education [^src2]. On an administrative level, Region Hovedstaden actively participates in the evaluation of national reports. For instance, the region reviewed the [[danibd-aarsrapport-2024]] and submitted its formal hearing response without any specific remarks or objections to the report's findings [^src4].

## Claims
Demographic:
- I perioden 1/10/2022 – 30/09/2023 blev der registreret i alt 11.211 patienter med IBD i Region Hovedstaden, 3.897 i Region Sjælland, 7.181 i Region Syddanmark, 7.520 i Region Midtjylland og 3.572 i Region Nordjylland [^src1] (region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland)

Diagnostic:
- DK50* Crohns sygdom udgjorde 40 % af alle IBD-patienter i Region Hovedstaden, 45 % i Region Sjælland, 41 % i Region Syddanmark, 43 % i Region Midtjylland og 40 % i Region Nordjylland [^src1] (dk50-crohns-sygdom, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland)
- DK51* Ulcerøs colitis udgjorde 58 % af alle IBD-patienter i Region Hovedstaden, 55 % i Region Sjælland, 59 % i Region Syddanmark, 56 % i Region Midtjylland og 60 % i Region Nordjylland [^src1] (dk51-ulceroes-colitis, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland)
- Antallet af patienter med DK830F Primær skleroserende kolangitis var 128 i Region Hovedstaden, 10 i Region Sjælland, 41 i Region Syddanmark, 55 i Region Midtjylland og 14 i Region Nordjylland [^src1] (dk830f-primaer-skleroserende-kolangitis, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland)

Administrative:
- Region Hovedstaden har ingen bemærkninger til årsrapport 2024 for DANIBD [^src1] (region-hovedstaden, danibd-aarsrapport-2024)
